claims: The MacBook Neo is available to students, educators, and staff through the Apple Education Store.
The starting price of the MacBook Neo is $499 (originally $599).
The MacBook Neo features an A18 Pro chip.
The entry-level MacBook Neo has 256GB storage.
The MacBook Neo has a 13-inch Liquid Retina display.
Upgrading to 512GB storage with Touch ID costs $599 via education pricing.
The discounted price for the 256GB MacBook Neo model is $499.
The discounted price for the 512GB MacBook Neo model is $599.
Eligibility for the MacBook Neo student discount includes college students, parents buying for college students, and faculty/staff of all grade levels.
Verification for the MacBook Neo student discount is not always required instantly.
Apple may randomly require verification for the MacBook Neo student discount via email, such as a school ID or enrollment proof.
The MacBook Neo is available online at the Apple Education Store.
The MacBook Neo is available at physical Apple Store locations.
Education customers can receive 3% Daily Cash back with the Apple Card.
Education customers can receive 10% off AppleCare+.
The MacBook Neo is marketed as a competitor to Chromebooks.
